sections.text: Power Stations
Technical Procedure

Equipment:
 Electric Gate Valve
MOSTRO S 41 123
Introduction

This document lists the 
maintenance procedure of electric gate valve, depending on external / internal 
leakage.

This valve used as fully opening or closing completely (Open / closed only 
 state)

The first draft initiated and 
tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Basuoni at 14 Jan 2004, accepted by General Director 
eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPC eng. Samir Abdel-Gelil, and approved by eng. Awad 
Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head Sector of Talkha power station.
Technical specification of equipment
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, etc.

Isolate valve mechanically and 
electrically.

Drain the pipeline, which connected to 
this valve.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Suitable lifting device.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Before Isolating the Valve 
Mechanically & Electrically

Check any leakage from valve gland. If it 
 found, retighten on gland bolts.

Check any leakage from the pressure tight 
 cover. If it found retighten the cover nut.
Check any internal leakage.

Check any leakage from the valve bodies 
 (cracks or mechanical wear). Remark the point of leakage.

Check the operation of the valve drive 
 during closing/ opening of the valve.

sections.text:
After Isolating the Valve 
Mechanically & Electrically

Be sure the valve was out of operation and the pressure inside 
the pipeline connected to the valve must be zero from the two end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Be sure the circuit breaker isolated for electric drive type.

sections.text: Disassembly the valve

Screw off the nuts (24) of gland bolts 
(22).
Take up gland follower (12).

Dismantle the sleeve (11) with glands 
bolt.
Screw off nut (18).

Take up plate (17) by using two 
withdraws.

Take out the dividing ring (16) and 
take up the ring (15).

Turn the hand wheel (3) to open it 
then the end of spindle (8) pressed on the bottom of pressure tight cover (5) 
and take it up.

Screw off the nuts (23) and bolts 
(21), which connected yoke (9) with nipple (2).

Take out the yoke (9) with spindle 
(8), with wedge (7) with all parts above.

Take out the wedge (7) from spindle 
(8).

Turn the spindle ( 8 ) until goes out 
from spindle nut (10).

Take out the gland follower (12) from 
spindle (8).

Withdraws the spindle (8) from 
pressure tight cover (5).

Take out the sealing (27) and gland 
sealing (28) from pressure tight cover (5).

Screw off bolt (34), which connected 
electric drive (33) with box (32) .

Lift the electric drive with suitable 
lifting device.

Withdraw the coupling half from the 
drive gear shaft (38).

Screw off bolts (35) and take out 
cover (36) of box (32) .

Take out the gear drive (38) with its 
shaft (39) by hammering on the lower end.

Takes out the bearing (31) of the gear 
drive (38).

Screw off the nut (40) and then take 
out gear (41).

With draw the gear wheel (30) from the 
spindle nut (10).

Take out the 
box (32).

Screw 
off the bolts (42) and then take out flange (29).

Take out the spindle nut (10) from 
yoke (9), bearing (26) and dust seal (20).

sections.text: Inspection and Repair of all Parts

Check the valve wedge (7) and regrind 
the sealing surface of it if needed.

Check the valve seat (saddle) (4) and 
regrind it if needed. When grinding the seats of the movers, attention must be 
paid to maintaining the angles of the sealing surfaces. In order to secure the 
mover function it is not allowed to reduce the seat parts by more than 0.8 mm in 
total (not more than 0.4 mm for one surface).

Repair the valve wedge (7) and valve 
seats (4) in a specialist workshop if grinding can not repair the wear in there.

Check the spindle (8) and repair it if 
needed or replace it.

Check the spindles nut (10) and repair 
it if needed or replace it.

Check the bearing (26) and replace it 
if needed.

Check the dust seal rings (20) and 
replace them if needed.

Check the bush (14) and repair it if 
needed or replace it.

Check the coupling insert and replaced 
if it needed.

Check the gears (38) , (41) , (30) 
and bearing (31).

Check the body (1), nipple (25) from 
any cracks or wear by using penetration fluids and repair it if found by using 
suitable filler material or its equivalent acc. to table (1).
If the valve damaged, change it w.r.t. the material as stated in table 1

sections.text: Assembly of Valve

Clean every part well before any 
assembly.

Assembly the valve parts in reverse 
sequence of disassembly.

items:
Clean every part well before any 
assembly.

Assembly the valve parts in reverse 
sequence of disassembly.

sections.text: Replace the Packing of Valve Gland

Clean the stuffing box chamber and the 
cover well.
Lubricate the gland bolts and nuts.
Use suitable size of packing.

Wire the suitable packing size on a 
part of shaft with the same diameter of valve spindle.

Cut all packing rings along the shaft 
by using sharp knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box 
chamber with the cut turned 180 , 
starting at 9 clock.
Tighten the gland bolts.

Open 
and close the valve and be sure that the valve operation is correct.
